title: SkeensMP Season 8
description: This is the modpack used for Season 8 of the SkeensMP. It is largely based on exploration and building.
body:
This is the modpack used for Season 8 of the SkeensMP, a private multiplayer survival server. This modpack adds various mods to enhance the exploration and building experience, whilst rewarding players who engage in automation and other technical aspects of the game. 

- Biomes O'Plenty and Oh the Biomes We've gone add over 30 new biomes to explore, and structure datapacks like MVS add over 200 structures to the game!
- Lootr allows all loot to be player-instanced, letting anyone explore structures without worrying about ruining the experience for other players.
- Classic Pipes allows players to experiment with new storage systems!
- Nycto allows magic-interested players to hunt or become a vampire!
